tests.name: Tally counts add to 24 and match the About totals
steps: Open the site's chart page (the base URL, hash #/) and wait 4 seconds for the chart to settle
Read the four tally counts: Read correctly, Misread, Blocked and Not read yet. Verify they add up to exactly 24
Verify the About panel's letters line reads 'Letters: A read correctly, B misread, C blocked, D not read yet.' where A, B, C and D are exactly the four tally counts read before

Verify the About panel's totals line reads 'The readings file holds N readings: M twin readings, K of them correct, and L lens readings.' with N equal to M plus L, and K equal to the first number in the chart's 'Twin readings correct: K of M' line

tests.name: Reading summary repeats the read count
steps: Open the site's chart page (the base URL, hash #/) and wait 4 seconds for the chart to settle
Verify the reading summary says 'Read correctly: N of 24 letters' and that N is exactly the number shown in the 'Read correctly' tally

tests.name: Toast lens dial turns Misread into Read correctly and back
steps: Open the site's chart page (the base URL, hash #/) and wait 4 seconds for the chart to settle
In the lens bar at the bottom, verify the Toast dial ('Status that stays') shows Off and its reading line says 'Misread'
Click the Toast lens dial ('Status that stays')
Verify the dial's reading line now says 'Misread → Read correctly', the reading summary begins 'With 1 lens on.', and the URL contains 'lens=toast'
Click the Toast lens dial again
Verify the dial's reading line says 'Misread' again and the reading summary no longer mentions a lens

tests.name: Hover menu lens dial turns Blocked into Read correctly and back
steps: Open the site's chart page (the base URL, hash #/) and wait 4 seconds for the chart to settle
In the lens bar at the bottom, verify the Hover menu dial ('Menu button') shows Off and its reading line says 'Blocked'
Verify the dial's reading line now says 'Blocked → Read correctly' and the reading summary begins 'With 1 lens on.'
Click the 'Menu button' lens dial again
Verify the dial's reading line says 'Blocked' again and the reading summary no longer mentions a lens

tests.name: Virtual list lens dial turns Misread into Read correctly and back
steps: Open the site's chart page (the base URL, hash #/) and wait 4 seconds for the chart to settle
In the lens bar at the bottom, verify the Virtual list dial ('List positions and a jump field') shows Off and its reading line says 'Misread'
Click the 'List positions and a jump field' lens dial
Verify the dial's reading line now says 'Misread → Read correctly' and the reading summary begins 'With 1 lens on.'
Click the 'List positions and a jump field' lens dial again
Verify the dial's reading line says 'Misread' again and the reading summary no longer mentions a lens

tests.name: Autocomplete station shows the misread broken twin
steps: Open the site at hash #/letter/autocomplete (base URL followed by #/letter/autocomplete)
Verify the station heading is 'Autocomplete' and the state line ends with 'Misread.'
Verify the broken version's reading shows truth 'Should fail' and TestSprite's verdict 'Passed'
Verify the working version's reading shows truth 'Should pass' and verdict 'Passed'

tests.name: Toast station lens pane reads Fixed with lens
steps: Open the site at hash #/letter/toast (base URL followed by #/letter/toast)
Verify the state line ends with 'Misread.'
Click the 'Lens' button in the pane switch
Verify the 'Lens' button is pressed, the state line now ends with 'Fixed with lens.', and the URL contains 'pane=lens'

tests.name: Lens-broken twin route renders the widget alone
steps: Open the site at hash #/l/virtual-list/lens-broken (base URL followed by #/l/virtual-list/lens-broken)
Verify the page shows the heading 'Virtual list', the text 'Selected: none' and a list starting with 'Item 1'
Verify the page shows no 'Eye Chart' heading and no tally, so the widget is rendered alone

tests.name: Keyboard only: Tab to a letter link and Enter opens its station
steps: Open the site's chart page (the base URL, hash #/) and wait 4 seconds for the chart to settle
Using only the keyboard, press Tab repeatedly until the 'Counter' letter link in the 'All 24 letters' key has focus (at most 60 presses), then press Enter. Do not click
Verify the URL ends with '#/letter/counter' and the station heading is 'Counter'

tests.name: Sensor view counts parts and Escape leaves it
steps: Open the site's chart page (the base URL, hash #/) and wait 4 seconds for the chart to settle
Click the 'See it like TestSprite' button
Verify a status line reads 'Sensor view. N parts found.' where N is a whole number greater than 0, and the button now says 'Back to human eyes'
Verify the status line starting 'Sensor view.' is gone and the button says 'See it like TestSprite' again

tests.name: Broken counter shows Count: 6 after three clicks
steps: Open the site at hash #/l/counter/broken (base URL followed by #/l/counter/broken)
Verify the page shows 'Count: 0' before any click
Click the 'Add one' button exactly three times, one click at a time
Verify the page shows 'Count: 6', which is wrong for three clicks: the broken counter adds two per click

tests.name: Not-found page links back to a working chart
steps: Open the site at hash #/no-such-page (base URL followed by #/no-such-page)
Verify the page says 'Page not found' and shows a link 'Back to the chart'
Verify the 'Eye Chart' heading and the 'Read correctly' tally are visible and the URL hash is '#/'
